note: Independent round-2 audit of only running and session_reset plus composition with all 16 unchanged neighbours, read side by side against English and context. Unchanged keys are context only, not newly certified. tourne denotes ongoing execution rather than a completed launch; idiomatic compact computing French. session réinit. is an intelligible abbreviation of session réinitialisée and preserves the fresh-session warning without implying call failure. Both preserve lowercase terse status register, exact argument parity, and absence of plural/markup tokens; neither contains English UI prose. Runtime verification used the primary repo .venv/bin/python with PYTHONPATH pinned to this worktree (module origin confirmed). No scoped key is at or above maxCells. Consumer also inspected: tool_card.py running_label uses settled-spine padding to seven cells; _status_runs sheds whole words below cap; _outcome_runs uses reset fallback as amber reason beside success glyph. Session reset is 15 cells versus English 13, below its 16-cell cap; no extra rendered overflow check indicated by this delta. No repository edits or ledger append performed.
